## Description {#details}

Represents a named group of test cases that self-register to the runner.

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-suite">test&#95;suite</Link></code> class extends <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-suite-base">test&#95;suite&#95;base</Link></code> and enables the registration and execution of callable objects (such as lambdas or function pointers) as test suites. Upon construction, each test suite automatically registers itself with the test runner, facilitating automated test discovery and execution across different components and folders of a project.

This class template provides a flexible mechanism for grouping related test cases and managing their execution within the µTest++ framework. It ensures that test suites are non-copyable and non-movable, maintaining unique ownership and consistent state.

All members and methods are defined within the <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus</Link></code> namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.

### test&#95;suite() {#a824b38d21a3f4d0adb99827455f159cf}

<MemberDefinition
  template={<>template &lt;typename Callable&#95;T, typename... Args&#95;T&gt;</>}
  prototype={<>micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::test&#95;suite::test&#95;suite (const char &#42; name, Callable&#95;T &amp;&amp; callable, Args&#95;T &amp;&amp;... arguments)</>}>
Class template constructor for <Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-suite">test&#95;suite</Link>.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="Callable&#95;T">The type of a callable object.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="Args&#95;T">The types of the callable arguments.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="[in] name">The test case name or description, used in reports.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="[in] callable">A generic callable object, usually a lambda, invoked to perform the test.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="[in] arguments">A possibly empty list of arguments to be passed to the callable.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
The rule of five is enforced to prevent accidental copying or moving.

This constructor initialises a test suite by binding the provided callable and its arguments, and registers the suite with the test runner.

The callable is bound using <code>std::bind</code>, allowing for flexible test suite definitions with arbitrary arguments. Upon construction, the test suite is automatically registered with the global runner for execution.

### ~test&#95;suite() {#aed21554ac8fa83e61ce178f37b0cdac8}

<MemberDefinition
  prototype={<>micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::test&#95;suite::~test&#95;suite ()</>}
  labels = {["virtual"]}>
Virtual destructor for the <Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-suite">test&#95;suite</Link> class.

The destructor releases any resources associated with the <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-suite">test&#95;suite</Link></code> instance.
